Julius Baer India has appointed Jayesh Kothari as Chief Human Resources Officer, India, effective 17 September 2026. The appointment comes as the firm continues to expand its India operations, with a focus on growing its relationship manager base and strengthening its mid-office functions.
As the business scales, leadership depth and organisational capabilities will remain key priorities, alongside developing internal talent and creating career pathways for employees.

Kothari brings more than 25 years of experience in financial services, having worked with businesses across private banking, investment banking, markets, asset and wealth management, insurance and shared services.
His career has included roles across both growth and transformation environments, with a focus on talent, leadership development and organisational effectiveness.

Kothari joins Julius Baer from Barclays, where he spent 11 years in senior HR leadership roles. Most recently, he served as Interim HR Business Partner for the Private Bank business, supporting the UK and Crown Dependencies as well as international private banking locations across Switzerland, Monaco, Ireland, the UAE, India and Singapore.

Prior to this, he was HR Business Partner for Barclays Private Bank in APAC. During his tenure at Barclays, Kothari was involved in shaping talent strategies and supporting business transformation initiatives.
Before joining Barclays, Kothari held senior HR leadership positions at Kotak Mahindra Capital, Lehman Brothers, HSBC Securities & Capital Markets and ICICI Lombard General Insurance.
He holds an MBA in Human Resources and a PG Certificate in Human Resource Management from XLRI, Jamshedpur.
